title: botrychium dissectum f. oneidense
intro: Botrychium dissectum f. oneidense, commonly known as Oneida fern, is a rare and endangered species of the Ophioglossaceae family, belonging to the genus Botrychium and characterized by its unique dissected fronds. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress, improving immune function, and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Oneida fern include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Botrychium dissectum f. oneidense include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
